Create Encounter.description: Registers an outpatient visit (Encounter) for a patient at a facility.

Create Observation.description: Records a vital sign (e.g. body temperature) against a patient's encounter.

Create Condition.description: Records an ICD-10 diagnosis (Condition) for a patient encounter.

Create Immunization.description: Reports a vaccine dose given to a patient.

Update Encounter Status.description: Patches an existing Encounter, e.g. to mark the visit finished, using JSON Patch.

Create Location.description: Registers a room or unit (Location) under your organization.

Find Patient By NIK.description: Looks up a patient's SATUSEHAT (IHS) id from their national identity number (NIK).

Find Practitioner By NIK.description: Looks up a health worker's SATUSEHAT (IHS) id from their NIK.

Get Patient Encounters.description: Lists the encounters recorded for a patient.

Get Encounter Observations.description: Lists observations recorded during a specific encounter.

Get Organization By ID.description: Reads one Organization resource by its SATUSEHAT id.
